text:
mina-mkt: Quick thought  start a TinyLaunch Labs series: weekly micro-tutorial + one-file OSS refapp + tiny benchmark card. friction <5min. good way to pull new devs in.
devrel-jo: love it. call-to-action: "Run in 5". each post = 2-min read, 1 runnable snippet, 1 Docker run and a benchmark snapshot.
pete-eng: agree. refapp constraints: single file (py/node), endpoints: /health /infer /embed, env REDWOOD_API_KEY. minimal deps, single Dockerfile.
anya-ux: visuals: compact benchmark card (p50/p95, cost/1k) + 5s GIF template. i'll make two hero variants for A/B.
sam-sales: inbound: add a tiny form at bottom capturing use-case, company size, and demo interest. if enterprise checked -> webhook to CRM + AE queue. small teams -> nurture drip.
mina-mkt: bench narrative: compare hosted-small, dedicated-default, private-quantized. metrics: p50, p95, cost per 1k tokens. show tradeoffs in one small table.
pete-eng: i'll create bench scripts that run a 256-token workload and output CSV. add a GH Action to publish CSV on release. will add secret-scan.
devrel-jo: distribution: blog + tweet thread + community newsletter + pinned GH issue. week 3 -> 30m office hours demo. encourage PRs with label "tinylaunch-contrib".
anya-ux: CTA variants ready by Monday; GIF template by Tuesday.
sam-sales: inbound routing detail: blog form -> Google Sheet -> Zapier -> CRM or Slack #sales-inbound. include timezone field for office hour invites.
ops-bot: CI checklist created: lint -> build image -> bench -> publish artifact. recommend redaction of keys and 30-day artifact retention.
mina-mkt: timeline (pilot): week0 scaffold + baseline bench, week1 publish Snack #1, week2 Snack #2, week3 Snack #3 + office hours, week4 community picks + recap.
devrel-jo: i'll draft Snack #1 ("Quick reranker in 5") today and open the repo. pete, can you have bench scripts + template repo by EOD Friday?
pete-eng: yes, will do.
mina-mkt: assign: jo(content+refapp), pete(repo+bench), anya(visuals), sam(inbound). we'll measure signups, PRs, conversions. :rocket:
